entries.purpose: Rebuild an existing WireGuard client config and QR code from the current saved keypair.
customer_config_writes: backup copies beside existing client artifacts
entries.audit_behavior: Writes v7-audit-log user_reissue_config event when v7-audit-log is available.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: Does not print private keys, but writes configs containing private keys and QR material.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only in repo; do not execute against live client artifacts in tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Supports --dry-run, but normal mode writes client config/QR and chmods generated artifacts. Lineage copy only; no live action.

entries.purpose: Rotate a user's WireGuard client keypair and rebuild runtime/user profile artifacts.
entries.audit_behavior: Writes v7-audit-log user_rotate_key event when v7-audit-log is available.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: Does not print private keys, but rotates and writes key material.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only in repo; do not execute against live users or WireGuard state.
entries.special_safety_notes: High-risk customer-affecting tool. Normal mode requires --confirm ROTATE, mutates wg0 config, can run wg set, and calls v7-routing-sync for enabled users.

entries.purpose: Generate smart client profiles for Karing/Hiddify/Happ from WireGuard configs or proxy identity bindings.
key_material_reads: WireGuard client config PrivateKey/PublicKey/PresharedKey when generating sing-box based profiles
proxy UUID from proxy identity binding when generating Happ subscription
entries.audit_behavior: No audit write observed in script.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: --print-redacted redacts WireGuard private/public/PSK and VLESS UUID; normal output writes profile secrets to files and reports secrets=written_to_output_not_printed.
entries.verification_requirement: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp python3 -m py_compile only; no live profile generation in repo tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Dry-run validates and prints output path. Happ mode checks systemd service activity and embeds proxy credential material; do not execute against live customer/profile state during lineage work.

entries.purpose: Create or preview a disabled proxy identity binding for a V7 user.
key_material_reads: existing proxy_uuid from binding file if present
key_material_writes: new proxy_uuid in disabled binding file when --apply is used
entries.audit_behavior: No audit write observed in script.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: Prints redacted proxy UUID in preview/apply output; full UUID is written to binding JSON.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only in repo; do not execute --apply or create live bindings.
entries.special_safety_notes: Preview mode writes only a temp file. Apply mode requires --confirm CREATE_PROXY_IDENTITY_BINDING and writes disabled binding metadata but does not start service/open ports/change routing.

entries.purpose: Preview or sync disabled proxy identity bindings from users.registry.
key_material_reads: existing proxy_uuid from binding files when present
key_material_writes: new proxy_uuid values in binding files when --apply is used
entries.audit_behavior: No audit write observed in script.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: Preview output redacts proxy UUIDs; write payload contains full UUIDs.
entries.verification_requirement: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp python3 -m py_compile only; do not execute against live bindings.
entries.special_safety_notes: Preview mode prints a plan. Apply mode requires --confirm SYNC_PROXY_IDENTITIES and writes disabled binding files.

entries.purpose: Read-only multi-user proxy identity readiness check.
key_material_reads: proxy UUIDs from runtime config and binding files
customer_config_reads: ip rule, ip link, ss, systemctl state, recent journal lines
entries.audit_behavior: No audit write observed in script.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: Redacts proxy UUIDs in human output and technical JSON.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only in repo; do not execute against live proxy identity state as part of lineage tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Creates and removes a temporary directory for intermediate read-only snapshots. Declares would_write_files=no and does not change routing/firewall/service state.

entries.purpose: Temporary loopback-only two-identity VLESS canary/probe for positive and blocked identity behavior.
key_material_reads: runtime proxy UUID from sing-box config
key_material_writes: temporary generated UUID in /tmp probe config
entries.audit_behavior: No audit write observed in script.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: Prints redacted UUIDs for generated identities.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only in repo; do not execute live probe during lineage work.
entries.special_safety_notes: Requires --confirm RUN_PROXY_TWO_IDENTITY_PROBE. It starts temporary sing-box processes, performs curl probes, and kills temporary PIDs. It does not persist runtime config, but is not a passive read-only tool.
